user.title: BMS Intercom
user.description: Choose how to set up the intercom.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: A virtual intercom for testing without hardware.

data_description.channel: 101 = main stream, 102 = sub stream, 1 = legacy panels
data_description.use_alert_stream: alertStream: the panel pushes call events. Turn off for models without it — the call status is then polled.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check IP, port and credentials.
error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the credentials (401). Check the login and that the user has ISAPI rights.

init.title: BMS Intercom settings
init.description: The browser microphone only works over HTTPS; the integration starts a local HTTPS endpoint automatically. You can also change the panel video channel, turn the event stream off and set the call reset timeout here.

data_description.channel: 101 = main stream, 102 = sub stream, 1 = legacy panels
data_description.use_alert_stream: alertStream: the panel pushes call events. Turn off for models without it — the call status is then polled.
data_description.call_timeout: If the panel never reports the end of a call, the state returns to idle after this long.
data_description.proxy_port: 8443 by default. Needed for the browser microphone (secure context).

error.https_required: The address must start with https://

probe.name: Probe the panel
probe.description: Probes the known ISAPI endpoints and writes a report to the log and to the «Проверить панель» button attributes. The password never appears in it.

entry_id.name: Intercom
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Empty = probe them all.

test_door.name: Test the door relay
test_door.description: WARNING: really opens the door. Off by default.

minutes.name: Event log, minutes
minutes.description: How many recent minutes of the terminal's event log (AcsEvent) to show. 15 by default.
